name: Qwen Audio Agent
tagline: A realtime voice runtime so AI agents can speak, work, and be present
description: Qwen Audio Agent is a realtime voice runtime for AI agents, letting an agent speak, work, and remain present in a conversation. It targets fluid, low-latency spoken interaction layered on top of agent backends. The project extends the Qwen audio ecosystem into agentic, always-on voice use cases.
highlights: Realtime voice runtime for AI agents
Enables agents to speak and remain present in conversations
Built within the Qwen audio ecosystem
curatorNote: Voice-first agents are the next frontier — this runtime gives agents a realtime presence, making it a useful reference for anyone building spoken interactions.
